string.name: acc_where_body
string.value: On this phone, in encrypted storage. With an account, a copy of your profile and medicines is kept in your account (Supabase). Only you can read it: every row is locked to your login.

string.value: Your watch's heart data is kept under your account, so only you can see it. Without an account the app shows the demo watch.

string.value: SOS ALERTS FROM YOUR WATCH

string.name: acc_sos_switch
string.value: Let my watch alert my contacts

string.name: acc_sos_explain
string.value: When your watch sends an SOS, our server texts and calls your emergency contacts. For that it keeps their names and numbers and your first name in your account. Off unless you switch it on; switching it off deletes them.

string.name: acc_sos_needs_watch
string.value: Pair a watch first (Settings → Watch).

string.name: acc_sos_skipped
string.value: %d contacts were left out: add the country code to their number, e.g. +48 600 123 456.

string.name: acc_sos_offline
string.value: Offline. The contacts will be sent when you're online.

string.name: acc_sos_error
string.value: Couldn't update the contacts on the server. Try again later.

string.name: acc_sos_last_partial
